records.notes: Walk-in during distribution hours; no appointment needed. New clients must enroll in person during enrollment hours (arrive by 12:45 p.m. on Wednesdays). Only the applicant should enter the lobby; children may accompany them. New clients receive a starter order on the day they enroll and their first full order the following month.

services.description: ACTS Hunger Prevention Center provides food assistance to enrolled households once per month. Depending on availability, households receive canned goods, rice, pasta, peanut butter and jelly, bread, cereal, meat or fish, fresh fruits and vegetables, and dairy. Non-clients are offered an emergency bag of food and information on enrollment. A home delivery program serves homebound seniors aged 65 and older and people whose disability prevents them from coming in person, with deliveries once a month. ACTS is a Capital Area Food Bank partner participating in USDA programs, and partners with the Greater DC Diaper Bank to provide diapers and infant supplies. Services are offered in English and Spanish.
